hero.description: I’m Zainab. I help businesses connect with the right people through Meta, TikTok and Google ads—with a human perspective behind every campaign.

process: Your business, your customer, your offer. We start with the right questions before making channel decisions.
Turn those answers into a practical campaign plan: audiences, message, creative direction and a clear next step.
Launch with agreed goals and measurement. Compare meaningful variations and give each test a purpose.
Review what the data tells us, make informed changes and keep you in the loop with clear reporting.

paragraphs: I’m Zainab Abdullah—a digital marketer, psychologist and business analyst. I bring curiosity about people and clarity about processes to the way I approach growth.

I’ve worked with clients around the world through Upwork, Fiverr, Instagram and LinkedIn. My digital marketing work began in July 2026, alongside more than two years of experience in business analysis.
